# Bibliotecas de terceiros empacotadas

Arquivos gerados por `npm run vendorizar`. O codigo-fonte permanece nos pacotes npm.

| Arquivo | Pacote | Versao | Licenca |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chart.esm.js` | `chart.js` | 4.6.1 | MIT — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md |
| `gsap.esm.js` | `gsap` | 3.13.0 | GreenSock Standard License (gratuito) — https://gsap.com/standard-license |

## Fontes

IBM Plex Sans 5.2.6 (SIL Open Font License 1.1), subconjunto latino, pesos 300, 400, 500, 600.
Copiadas de `node_modules/@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans/files/` para `src/frontend/assets/fontes/`.
